name: 夕阳再现
english_name: Sunset Reappears: Storm Rises Again II
english_description: This is the "Storm Rises Again II" branch of Sunset Reappears. Its login and registration flow closely resembles sibling archives xysylmhb and xyzxiiylzymh, but its map data is the genuine Sunset Reappears lineage — byte-identical to jhfy3 and xajh4gkb — whereas those two similarly-branded siblings actually run on an unrelated "Tianya" map family, the same "shared core, swapped map" pattern seen elsewhere in this collection. Unlike its siblings, this build doesn't require the old Tomud client handshake on its standard port.
